title: Large-Format Magnetic Tiles – Building Set in a Box with a Handle
descriptionHtml:
Building toys die when the pieces are too small

Fifty tiny pieces under the sofa, a broken manual and a child who gave up after ten minutes. More gets built on the screen than on the floor.

Big tiles that click together on their own

Large-format magnetic tiles that pull together the right way – towers, houses and vehicles take shape without a manual. Comes in a box with a handle so the build is put away as fast as it is taken out. Choose 46 or 60 pieces.

Features

  • The build works right away – the magnets settle into place by themselves
  • Big tiles, no small parts in the sofa – made for smaller hands
  • Cleaned up in a minute – everything goes into the box with a handle
  • Grows with the child – geometry and balance without them noticing

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
